capabilities: Render JSON code blocks as nested tables
Open .json vault files as interactive tables
Sort, filter, and group table rows by column
Reload tables when referenced JSON files change
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table editor; it only renders JSON data as tables.
extras: Described as a premium plugin; installation is manual only (copying release files into .obsidian/plugins/), and the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian displays JSON files and code blocks as raw code, with no structured, interactive way to read or explore the data.
summary: JSON table viewer that renders JSON code blocks and .json files as interactive, recursively nested tables with sorting, filtering, and grouping.
